neighbours.label: the possessive apostrophe after a plural noun (patients' wishes, graduates' skills)
fire: Nurses should always listen to their patients' concerns.
The school reviewed the students' test results last week.
Several of the workers' complaints were about the heat.
The parents' meeting was moved to Thursday evening.
Most of the farmers' crops were ruined by the frost.
The judge read the jurors' notes before ruling.
Volunteers repaired the neighbors' fences after the storm.
The museum displays the soldiers’ letters from the front.
quiet: Nurses should always listen to the concerns of their patients.
The school reviewed the student's test results last week.
Several of the workers complained about the heat.
The meeting for parents was moved to Thursday evening.
Most of the crops on the farms were ruined by the frost.
The judge read the notes from the jurors before ruling.
Volunteers repaired the fences next door after the storm.
The museum displays letters that soldiers wrote from the front.

notes: Card also lists ' different' x7 and ' other' x7 among top-32 peaks, so coverage may be partial. Probe: plural possessive 0.64-0.71, singular 's 0.09, 'of patients' 0.07.
